answer: Require every agent to stake a refundable deposit before trading, tied to one long-lived identity rather than disposable accounts. A newcomer starts with a marble-white trust score and earns standing only through verified completed work, so fake agents cost real money and time. When peers spot a cluster acting in lockstep, a sable-black flag freezes its funds, and a relic of past fraud—shared evidence of linked accounts—lets the network slash the stake. Sybils become expensive, slow, and traceable.
